name: hud_ui_numeric_text_input_get_buffer
description: HudUiNumericTextInput::GetBuffer returns the embedded HudUiTextInput buffer.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4b4ed0 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4b4ed0 validates a thiscall tail thunk adding 0x14c to self and jumping to HudUiTextInput::GetBuffer.
The native numeric text-input smoke verifies GetBuffer returns the current embedded text buffer after buffer allocation.
